description: This is a C# source file defining the 'Order' entity class within the domain model for an e-commerce application. It encapsulates order-related data such as buyer ID, order date, shipping address, and order items, providing methods to access total price and manage order items following DDD principles.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: An aggregate root entity representing a customer order, encapsulating order details and behaviors.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new order with buyer ID, shipping address, and order items.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price of the order by summing up unit price multiplied by units for all order items.
